Tools for cleaning, filtering and converting Norwegian Vannmiljo water
monitoring data into the eData templates used by STOPeData, plus notes
on the Vannmiljo data model.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_data_quality()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/check_data_quality.md)
  : Generate a comprehensive data quality report
- [`classify_data_issue()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/classify_data_issue.md)
  : Classify the type of data issue for a value
- [`has_data_issue()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/has_data_issue.md)
  : Check if a value has any data quality issue (missing, not reported,
  or not relevant)
- [`is_missing()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/is_missing.md)
  : Check if a value is truly missing (NA, NULL, or empty string)
- [`is_not_relevant()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/is_not_relevant.md)
  : Check if a value is not relevant
- [`is_not_reported()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/is_not_reported.md)
  : Check if a value is not reported
- [`resolve_compartment_conflicts()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/resolve_compartment_conflicts.md)
  : Resolve environmental compartment conflicts between data sources
- [`resolve_geographic_conflicts()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/resolve_geographic_conflicts.md)
  : Resolve geographic feature conflicts between data sources
- [`summarise_vm_dataset()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/summarise_vm_dataset.md)
  : Summarise the Vannmiljø Dataset for the Manuscript
- [`vm_cleaning_funnel()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_cleaning_funnel.md)
  : Build the Vannmiljø Cleaning-Funnel Table
- [`vm_convert_operator()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_convert_operator.md)
  : Convert Vannmiljø operator symbols to eData measurement flags
- [`vm_convert_unit()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_convert_unit.md)
  : Convert Vannmiljø unit names to standardised eData units
- [`vm_create_edata_biota_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_biota_table.md)
  : Create eData biota table from intermediate samples-biota table
- [`vm_create_edata_campaigns_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_campaigns_table.md)
  : Create eData campaigns table from Vannmiljø data
- [`vm_create_edata_measurements_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_measurements_table.md)
  : Create eData measurements table from intermediate samples-biota
  table
- [`vm_create_edata_parameters_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_parameters_table.md)
  : Create eData parameters table for copper measurements
- [`vm_create_edata_reference_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_reference_table.md)
  : Create eData reference table for Vannmiljø data source
- [`vm_create_edata_samples_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_samples_table.md)
  : Create eData samples table from intermediate samples-biota table
- [`vm_create_edata_sites_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_edata_sites_table.md)
  : Extract and format unique Vannmiljø sites with geographic metadata
- [`vm_create_intermediate_samples_biota_table()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_create_intermediate_samples_biota_table.md)
  : Create intermediate samples-biota table for eData conversion
- [`vm_filter_compartments()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_filter_compartments.md)
  : Filter data by environmental compartments
- [`vm_filter_dates()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_filter_dates.md)
  : Filter data by date range
- [`vm_filter_sites()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_filter_sites.md)
  : Filter data by site type and excluded sites
- [`vm_matrix_class()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_matrix_class.md)
  : Classify an eData Row's Matrix as Water / Sediment / Biota
- [`vm_split_sites()`](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/reference/vm_split_sites.md)
  : Split sites with multiple geographic feature combinations

# Articles

### All vignettes

- [Milkys](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/milkys.md):

  A very quick review of Milkys - it only contains biota data.

- [Vanmniljø
  activities](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/some-activity-notes.md):

  An unfinished exploration of the activties represented in Vannmiljø.

- [Vannmiljø Data Exploration - Arctic &
  Marine](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-data-exploration.md):

  Exploring subsets of Vannmiljø data to see how much information they
  could give us about mixtures of pollutants in Arctic marine
  environments.

- [Variables in the Oslo January 2020
  export](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-data-variables.md):

  A walk through the columns of a raw Vannmiljø water-registration
  export, what each one means, and what we do with it on the way to
  eData.

- [Vanmniljø Arctic/Marine
  Exploration](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-expect-data.md):

  Exploring data relevant to the EXPECT case study.

- [Getting data from
  Vanmniljø](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-getting-data.md):

  How we get data from Vannmiljø. So far only covers the frontend.

- [Vannmiljø Pollutants - Arctic &
  Marine](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-pollutants.md):

  Exploring subsets of Vannmiljø data to see how much information they
  could give us about mixtures of pollutants in Arctic marine
  environments.

- [Converting sites and
  compartments](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-site-compartment-conversion.md):

  How we turn Vannmiljø’s site categories and sample media into eData
  compartments, geographic features and sites, and what gets dropped on
  the way.

- [Variables in the Oslo sites
  export](https://sawelch-niva.github.io/Vm2eData/articles/vannmiljo-site-variables.md):

  A walk through the columns of a raw Vannmiljø water-location (site)
  export, what each one means, and what we do with it on the way to
  eData.
